'''Robbie Walker''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[March 2001 Abbotsford tournament]] on 4 March 2001 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|BHBM (with Sense/Alter)]], according to Alan Sagan's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1847">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-05-abbotsford-bc-03-04-01d1847/ abbotsford-bc-03-04-01], DeckTech (Alan "Serpent" Sagan, 5 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-05-abbotsford-bc-03-04-01d1847/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
